scope: Independent checks of clean candidate public interface, captured original amp subset and bounded candidate mechanics. No original engine source used. No full Sound acceptance.

envelope_gate.metric: Maximum absolute error between candidate public amp snapshot AFTER rendering sample n and original measured first/last inferred amplitude at EXACT recorded frame n, all 2560 CSV rows; also compare candidate dry output/reference-output cancellation as black-box cross-check. No fitted time shift or re-fit of thresholds.
envelope_gate.justification: 0.1% of full-scale envelope. This is over 5000 times the largest reported 1.796592e-7 capture interpolation residual and safely covers binary32 recurrence noise while rejecting a 16-frame grid error or linear curve. It is an explicit scoped engineering acceptance threshold, not an original product audio-tolerance requirement.

negative_controls.name: wrong_time_grid
negative_controls.action: Compare same candidate contour shifted by exactly +16 frames to original timestamps. Must fail maxabs1e-3.

negative_controls.name: linear_envelope
negative_controls.action: Replace each timed contour with a linear AHDSHR segment using the physical durations. Must fail maxabs1e-3.

negative_controls.name: wrong_velocity
negative_controls.action: Compare candidate squared velocity mode to captured linear 127:1 gain requirement. Must fail normalized ratio tolerance1e-4.

velocity_gate.normalized_gain_ratio: output(v1)*127 / output(v127) at well-conditioned nonzero samples, default linear mode

lifecycle_gate: Part instances and layer/envelope states independent; serialized event timeline gives identical output and final state for all tested block partitions; sustain-up does not restart notes already in release; released note retires and allocation oldest policy remains correctly ordered; invalid arguments preserve state/output for explicitly validated errors.
finite_bound_gate: Finite accepted parameters and public events at sr8000/44100/48000/192000 keep output finite and within declared32.0 bound with float tolerance1e-5. Caller does not edit private state.
timing_scope: Host full callback-like sequence, including fixed explicitly counted event/control bursts, both parts and render; no native WCET/xrun inference. Counter audit includes omitted event/control operations.
